name: @agentide/desktop
description: AgentIDE - Open source agent-first IDE powered by Claude Code
author: AgentIDE Contributors

scripts.package:dev: cd ../app && ELECTRON=true bun run build && cd ../desktop && bun run clean:dev && NODE_ENV=development bun run build:dev && bun x electron-builder --config electron-builder.dev.yml --publish never && open ./release-dev
scripts.package:prod: cd ../app && ELECTRON=true bun run build && cd ../desktop && bun run clean:prod && NODE_ENV=production bun run build:prod && bun x electron-builder --config electron-builder.prod.yml --publish never && open ./release
